newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT FALLS ON BEARISH API DATA.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT FALLS ON BEARISH API DATA.

text.p: September Brent futures were softer in late trading on Wednesday, as the American Petroleum Statistics (API) data drive prices in the absence of other news.
September Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.76 per barrel, down nine cents from London's close of $18.85.
But the market was extremely thin, with only 37 lots traded.
API statistics which were released late Tuesday showed a rise in crude stocks of 2.7 million week on week.
NYMEX crudes was last traded at $19.88 per barrel, a fall of 11 cents from New York.
